action.objective: Play Kd1, escaping the check and the ...Qxg2/...Bxh4 pressure, keeping the queen active on f3.
action.rationale: Kd1 is the sole commit_ready move, verified at depth 4 with exact score -3 and full mate-in-one safety check (no mating reply; tactical and checking-chain refutation not_found). Broad search at depth 4 ranks it far ahead of Qg3 (-884, upper bound) and Qf2 (-916, upper bound), both of which lose the queen to the bishop/queen battery. The queen stays on f3 supporting the position, and the king vacates the e-file. No other legal move avoids heavy material loss, so committing the verified leader.
